fields.required_documents: Diploma Admission Letter, Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook

fields.required_documents: Aadhaar, Bank Account, 12th Marksheet, Income Certificate

fields.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students

fields.eligibility: Belonging to SC/ST/OBC category; Enrolled in recognized state university or college.
fields.required_documents: Community Certificate, Income Certificate, Domicile Certificate

fields.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
fields.description: Direct income support to all farming families.
fields.eligibility: Should have agricultural land
fields.required_documents: Land records, Aadhaar, Bank account details
fields.application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through village patwari

fields.name: MGNREGA
fields.description: Guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year.
fields.eligibility: Adult member of rural household
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar, Job card application
fields.application_process: Apply at nearest Gram Panchayat office

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
fields.description: Housing assistance for BPL and AAY families.
fields.target_beneficiaries: BPL and AAY families below poverty line
fields.eligibility: BPL/AAY family, Annual income < ₹1.80 lakhs
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar, BPL certificate, Income proof
fields.application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or online

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
fields.description: Collateral-free loans for small businesses and entrepreneurs.
fields.benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakhs at reasonable interest
fields.eligibility: Indian citizen, business plan required
fields.required_documents: Business plan, ID proof, Address proof
fields.application_process: Apply at participating banks or online

fields.name: National Scholarship Portal
fields.description: Multiple scholarships for students from classes 1 to postgraduate.
fields.eligibility: Student pursuing education, income limits apply
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar, Academic records, Income certificate

fields.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
fields.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments to all landholding farmer families.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and rural landholder farmers
fields.benefits: ₹6,000/year directly transferred to Aadhaar-seeded bank account (DBT)
fields.eligibility: Farmer families with cultivable landholding in revenue records; Aadhaar authenticated.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Record Details (Patta/Khatoni), Bank Passbook
fields.application_process: Online at pmkisan.gov.in, via Common Service Center (CSC), or State Agriculture Office.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
fields.description: Assistance for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities for rural families living in kutcha/dilapidated homes.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Houseless rural families and those living in 0, 1 or 2 room kutcha houses (SECC list)
fields.benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plain areas / ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas + 90 days MGNREGA wages
fields.eligibility: Identified through SECC 2011 priority list and verified by Gram Sabha.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, MGNREGA Job Card, Land Ownership Proof
fields.application_process: Through Gram Panchayat office or online via AwaasSoft portal.

fields.name: Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY Health Insurance
fields.description: World’s largest health assurance scheme providing comprehensive secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Vulnerable and low-income rural families (Bottom 40% population)
fields.benefits: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled hospitals.
fields.eligibility: Listed in SECC 2011 database or verified ration card holder under NFSA.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, PMJAY e-Card
fields.application_process: Create Ayushman Card at any empaneled hospital, CSC Center, or via PMJAY App.

fields.name: National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM - Aajeevika)
fields.description: Poverty alleviation initiative promoting self-employment and organization of rural poor into Self Help Groups (SHGs).
fields.target_beneficiaries: Rural women, SHGs, and marginalized households
fields.benefits: Revolving fund, Community Investment Fund (CIF), and collateral-free bank loans up to ₹20 Lakhs with interest subvention.
fields.eligibility: Rural women residing in target village clusters forming groups of 10-20 members.
fields.required_documents: SHG Resolution Copy, Member Aadhaar details, Group Bank Account
fields.application_process: Through Village Organization (VO), Block Resource Center, or Gram Panchayat Desk.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
fields.description: Financial subsidy and infrastructure development for aquaculture, pond fish farming, and biofloc units in rural villages.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Fish farmers, coastal/inland youth, SHGs, and rural entrepreneurs
fields.benefits: 40% to 60% capital subsidy on pond construction, motorized boats, cold storage, and fingerlings.
fields.eligibility: Individual farmers or cooperatives having access to water bodies or land.
fields.required_documents: Land/Water Lease Deed, Project Proposal, Aadhaar, Bank Details
fields.application_process: Submit DPR to District Fisheries Office or through PMMSY online portal.
